description: fairy_opening_volley (bundle.deobfuscated.js:61336-61419) loops over EVERY alive player Fairy-type member, re-finding the first alive enemy before each hit, gated by a single battle-wide fairyVolleyFired flag (not per-attacker) -- genuinely multi-attacker, unlike elec_lead's single lead. Clefairy #1 targets Magikarp (current_hp=1): a guaranteed kill, and the source's ternary SKIPS afterAttack entirely on a fainted target (no fairy_hit_two splash from this hit). Clefairy #2 then re-finds the first alive enemy -- now Spearow, since Magikarp is dead -- and its hit is nonfatal (current_hp=300), so afterAttack DOES fire and fairy_hit_two splashes 30% of that hit's damage onto Rattata (the next living opposing member found by skipping the target itself). Rattata must be untouched by Clefairy #1's turn and damaged by Clefairy #2's turn -- proving both the fatal-skip and the nonfatal-fire halves of the same ternary in one fixture, plus the per-attacker target re-lookup. Pre-fix Python already loops over both Fairy attackers but never calls after_attack at all, so Rattata is untouched in both cases.
